observations.notes: Assets >UZS 102tn (~11% system share), net loans >UZS 87.5tn, deposits >UZS 54tn, FY25 NPAT UZS 1.88tn (#2 in sector). Issued $300m perp AT1 in Oct-25 lifting Total CAR to ~19% (Tier 1 ~14.7%). Stage 3 loans & OREO 9.1% YE25; S&P revised outlook to Negative (Jul-26).

verdict.stance: Neutral / High-Carry Uzbek State Bank Under Asset Cleanup (BB / BB- Neg)
verdict.summary: Uzbekistan's #2/#3 corporate bank (>UZS 102tn assets, FY25 NPAT UZS 1.88tn) carries strong 19% Total CAR post-Oct-25 $300m AT1 issuance, but faces elevated 9.1% Stage 3/OREO ratios (potentially rising toward 12% during pre-privatization cleanup) and ~60% loan dollarization. S&P cut outlook to Negative (Jul-26) on privatization transition risks; Fitch remains BB Stable.

positives: Strong Total CAR (~19%, Tier 1 ~14.7%) following Oct-25 $300m perpetual AT1 placement.
Sector #2 FY25 profitability (UZS 1.88tn net profit) and ~11% banking system share.
Fitch BB Stable with state ownership still anchoring support ahead of stretched 2027 privatization timeline.
negatives: S&P BB- Negative outlook (Jul-26): Stage 3/OREO at 9.1% YE25 (could peak up to ~12% during legacy book cleanup).
High ~60% loan dollarization creating borrower FX mismatch risk.
Privatization transition could gradually reduce extraordinary sovereign support uplift.

background.business_overview: Third-largest bank in Uzbekistan (~11% system assets) focused on industrial/corporate banking, transforming toward commercial/SME/retail ahead of privatization.
background.asset_perimeter: Corporate, SME, retail banking and green/sustainability finance across Uzbekistan.
background.ownership_governance: Majority state-owned (Ministry of Economy & Finance / UFRD); IFC/EBRD transformation engagement.

recent_drivers: Jul-26: S&P affirmed BB- and revised outlook to Negative on Stage 3 cleanup (9.1% YE25) and privatization execution risk.
Mar-26: Fitch affirmed BB Stable (VR b); Oct-25 $300m perp AT1 lifted CAR to ~19%.
